form.label: Replay health
form.description: Is each dataset playing, and is it producing a steady flow of findings?

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype=replay_lab:status | stats count by dataset
index=_internal sourcetype=replay_lab:status dataset="$dataset$" state=on index=* | head 1 | table index

index=_internal sourcetype=replay_lab:status dataset="$dataset$" | head 1 | eval loop_hours=round(loop_seconds/3600,1), position_hours=round(position/3600,2), last_tick=strftime(at,"%F %T") | table last_tick state loop position_hours loop_hours events skipped_seconds

index=_internal sourcetype=replay_lab:status dataset="$dataset$" state=on | head 1 | eval now=if(playing="true" OR playing=1, "workday (playing)", "idle until next start"), day=loop | table mode now day next_start_text

panel.title: Findings per hour, by rule (all datasets)

search.query: `notable` | timechart span=1h count by search_name limit=20 useother=true

panel.title: Replayed events per hour, by sourcetype

search.query: | tstats count where index="$live_index$" by _time span=1h, sourcetype | xyseries _time sourcetype count
index=_internal sourcetype=replay_lab:status dataset="$dataset$" wrapped{}=* | eval at=strftime(at,"%F %T") | table at wrapped{} events
